summary: Golden Sun Technology Group Limited filed a Form 6-K disclosing the resignation of director Liming Xu effective September 23, 2026, attributed to personal reasons with no stated disagreement over operations, policies or practices, and the board's same-day appointment of Bekazela Matshazi to fill the vacancy. Matshazi has served as Co-Chief Executive Officer since September 2026 and is Chief Technology Innovation Officer of Homeboss AI. No price, stake, premium, advisor, recommendation or regulatory clock is stated. This is a routine, orderly board transition rather than a forced or abrupt departure; no deal or capital-markets implication to watch.
